verdict.rationale: Hummingbird's organization settings include an area for managing API Keys, but nothing shows those keys can be scoped, permission-limited, or issued as least-privilege credentials for an agent. Plain API key management is an adjacent feature, not scoped credential issuance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: update Profile Information, Narrative Templates, API Keys, and Login Message
